brand_notes: Imagine series sits between Alpha and Synchrony; Synchrony-derived titanium tweeter, carbon-fibre woofers, 8 ohm nominal but ~4.1 ohm minimum (eac-psb-imagine-b50, soundstage-nrc-psb-imagine-b50). Launch price ~$699 pair (2024) now $999 at Audio Advisor; PSB site is Canada-geolocated (CAD). PSB designs with NRC anechoic chamber.
takeaways: Klippel: LW ±2.2 dB, f3 64 Hz, sensitivity 83.9 dB (claimed 85), major DI discontinuity near 4 kHz
Both Erin and NRC measure ~4.1 ohm min, so '8 ohm' is below-iec; EPDR min 2.1 ohm
THD ~0.9% @86 dB, ~3.1% @96 dB; compression within ~1.1 dB at 102 dB above 100 Hz
Critics (SoundStage, Witchdoctor) very positive; Erin less so (wavy midrange)
US price risen from ~$700 to $999; no user reviews found
conflicts: f3 64 Hz (Erin) vs ~70-75 Hz LW (NRC, graph-read)
